episode_title: Pinching pennies, casting ballots: a midterms dispatch from the Midwest
script_en: Pinching pennies, casting ballots: a midterms dispatch from the Midwest.
The Midwest used to be known as an affordable place to live.
Lately, though, many people there are having a hard time making ends meet.
In this episode of The Sunday Story , Holly Edgell and Daniel Wheaton from NPR’s Midwest Newsroom bring us the voices of Midwesterners.
We hear about how people in the region are struggling financially, and how the affordability crisis is impacting their votes in the midterms.
